text_en: Therefore, my brothers and sisters, whom I love and long for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.
text_cn: 为此，我所亲爱的和所怀念的弟兄，我的喜乐和我的冠冕，我可爱的诸位！你们应这样屹立在主内。

text_en: I urge Euodia and I urge Syntyche to be of the same mind in the Lord.
text_cn: 我奉劝厄敖狄雅和欣提赫，要在主内有同样的心情。

text_en: Yes, and I ask you also, my loyal companion, help these women, for they have struggled beside me in the work of the gospel, together with Clement and the rest of my co-workers, whose names are in the book of life.
text_cn: 至于你，我忠诚的同伴，我也求你援助她们，因为她们曾伴随我为福音而奋斗，与克肋孟以及我的其他的同事一样，他们的名字已写在生命册上了。

text_en: Rejoice in the Lord always; again I will say, Rejoice.
text_cn: 你们在主内应当常常喜乐，我再说：你们应当喜乐！

text_en: Let your gentleness be known to everyone. The Lord is near.
text_cn: 你们的宽仁应当叫众人知道：主快来了。

text_en: Do not worry about anything, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God.
text_cn: 你们什么也不要挂虑，只在一切事上，以恳求和祈祷，怀着感谢之心，向天主呈上你们的请求；

text_en: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
text_cn: 这样，天主那超乎各种意想的平安，必要在基督耶稣内固守你们的心思念虑。

text_en: Finally, beloved, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is just, whatever is pure, whatever is pleasing, whatever is commendable, if there is any excellence and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.
text_cn: 此外，弟兄们！凡是真实的，凡是高尚的，凡是正义的，凡是纯洁的，凡是可爱的，凡是荣誉的，不管是美德，不管是称誉：这一切你们都该思念；

text_en: Keep on doing the things that you have learned and received and heard and seen in me, and the God of peace will be with you.
text_cn: 凡你们在我身上所学得的，所领受的，所听见的，所看到的；这一切你们都该实行：这样，赐平安的天主必与你们同在。

text_en: I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at last you have revived your concern for me; indeed, you were concerned for me, but had no opportunity to show it.
text_cn: 再者，我在主内非常喜欢，因为你们对我的关心又再次表现出来；你们始终是关心我，只不过缺少表现的机会。

text_en: Not that I am referring to being in need; for I have learned to be content with whatever I have.
text_cn: 我说这话，并不是由于贫乏，因为我已学会了，在所处的环境中常常知足。

text_en: I know what it is to have little, and I know what it is to have plenty. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret of being well-fed and of going hungry, of having plenty and of being in need.
text_cn: 我也知道受穷，也知道享受；在各样事上和各种境遇中，或饱饫（yù）、或饥饿、或富裕、或贫乏，我都得了秘诀。

text_en: I can do all things through him who strengthens me.
text_cn: 我赖加强我力量的那位，能应付一切。

text_en: In any case, it was kind of you to share my distress.
text_cn: 但是，你们也实在做得好，因为你们分担了我的困苦。

text_en: You Philippians indeed know that in the early days of the gospel, when I left Macedonia, no church shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving, except you alone.
text_cn: 你们斐理伯人也知道：当我在传福音之初，离开马其顿时，没有一个教会在支收的事项上供应过我，惟独只有你们；

text_en: For even when I was in Thessalonica, you sent me help for my needs more than once.
text_cn: 就连我在得撒洛尼时，你们不只一次，而且两次曾给我送来我的急需。

text_en: Not that I seek the gift, but I seek the profit that accumulates to your account.
text_cn: 我并不是贪求馈赠，我所贪求的，是归入你们账内的丰厚的利息。

text_en: I have been paid in full and have more than enough; I am fully satisfied, now that I have received from Epaphroditus the gifts you sent, a fragrant offering, a sacrifice acceptable and pleasing to God.
text_cn: 如今我已收到了一切，已富足了；我由厄帕洛狄托收到了你们所送来的芬芳的馨香，天主所悦纳中意的祭品，我已满够了。

text_en: And my God will fully satisfy every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
text_cn: 我的天主必要以自己的财富，在基督耶稣内，丰富满足你们的一切需要。

text_en: To our God and Father be glory forever and ever. Amen.
text_cn: 愿光荣归于天主，我们的父，至于世世。阿们。

text_en: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The friends who are with me greet you.
text_cn: 你们要在基督耶稣内问候各位圣徒；同我在一起的弟兄都问候你们。

text_en: All the saints greet you, especially those of the emperor’s household.
text_cn: 众位圣徒，特别是凯撒家中的圣徒，都问候你们。

text_en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
text_cn: 愿主耶稣基督的恩宠与你们的心神同在。阿们。
